summary: Adds a new skill for reagent kit bulk policy analysis following the established pattern in the library. This skill compares small-kit (24 runs/year) vs bulk-kit (12 runs/year) reagent restocking economics using an assay manifest JSON, carrier cost CSV, billing CSV with effective-month versioning, and lab override CSV with approval revisions. The trace demonstrated successful resolution of billing aliases and override logic, which are captured as explicit data resolution rules.
